environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MINTEGRAL_ACCESS_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Access Key from Mintegral AppGrowth > Account Management > Basic Information; sent as the access-key header of every Open API call.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MINTEGRAL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API Key from the same Basic Information page; never sent, only used to compute the per-request token = md5(api_key + md5(timestamp)).
